about: Form an alliance and get revenge, in the latest SRPG in the Disgaea franchise. Killia, a loner, is drawn into forming a rebel army with a group of Overlords to oppose Demon Emperor Void Dark, and prevent him from taking over all of the Netherworlds.
PS4 game can be controlled via PS Vita
summary: Form an alliance and get revenge, in the latest SRPG in the Disgaea franchise.
